theme: Modern Government / Admin SaaS + Mobile First Flow
description: A premium internal management system for BAZNAS BAZIS DKI Jakarta. The design matches the requested PDF specifications (Emerald 700 primary, Inter font, white rounded-2xl cards on light gray background) but elevates it to an award-winning level with 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for premium headings, fluid motion via Framer Motion, and a dedicated mobile-simulator layout for the OCR receipt scanner.

primary.description: Emerald-700. Used for main CTA, progress indicators, and positive success states.

secondary.description: Amber-600. Used for pending states, warnings, and secondary highlights.

accent.description: Sky-600. Used for informational alerts and active navigation items.

headings.instruction: Do not use Inter for headings. Plus Jakarta Sans adds a premium, modern government feel that perfectly suits the context while remaining highly legible.

body.instruction: As requested in the PDF spec, use Inter for all dashboard tables, forms, and small text for maximum legibility.

document.instruction: Use exclusively for the A4 KAK Document preview to replicate a formal, printable government document.

dashboard.cards: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm p-6
dashboard.header: Sticky header with backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80, z-50
dashboard.sidebar: Profile card on the left sidebar for quick context, vertical or horizontal tab navigation depending on viewport.

mobile_simulator.container: relative mx-auto border-gray-800 dark:border-gray-800 bg-gray-800 border-[14px] rounded-[2.5rem] h-[600px] w-[300px] shadow-xl overflow-hidden
mobile_simulator.instruction: For the 'Relawan Lapangan' OCR feature, render a mobile phone frame in the center of the screen to simulate the mobile-first field experience.

kak_document.container: max-w-4xl mx-auto bg-white shadow-lg p-12 lg:p-24 aspect-[1/1.414] border border-gray-200
kak_document.instruction: Render the AI-generated KAK and Report exactly like an A4 paper in a preview window.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly on sticky headers or modal overlays (bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-gray-200).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Keep shadows very tight and clean (shadow-sm) as per PDF request. No diffuse massive shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders (border-gray-200) on all cards to create structure and separation from the #f8fafc background.

motion.page_transitions: Framer motion opacity and y-axis subtle slide (initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}).
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on table rows (bg-slate-50), slight scale on stat cards (hover:-translate-y-1), and interactive button clicks (active:scale-95).
motion.scrolling: Implement Lenis smooth scrolling for the landing/dashboard wrapper.

components_strategy.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-lg with strong primary colors. Hover states must darken the background color slightly. No transparent text on hover.
components_strategy.tables: Shadcn UI tables with sticky headers. Group rows visually if needed. Emerald headers for RAB budget table.
components_strategy.charts: Use Chart.js (or Recharts) for 'Budget vs Realization' (Bar) and 'SLA Compliance' (Doughnut). Match the color palette exactly.
components_strategy.toast: Use Sonner for all success/error notifications (e.g., 'OCR scan complete', 'KAK Generated').
components_strategy.ocr_scanner: Simulate a camera viewfinder with a scanning line animation (framer-motion) over the receipt image, followed by a bottom sheet popping up with extracted OCR fields.

login_background.description: Abstract dark green smooth layers. Use this as a striking split-screen or hero background on the login page.

receipt_scan_context.description: Use as a placeholder image inside the mobile OCR simulator before a user 'takes a photo' of the receipt.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the PDF color codes: Primary Emerald 700 (#047857), App Background #f8fafc.
Ensure all cards use rounded-2xl, border-gray-200, and shadow-sm.
Implement 3 distinct tabs/views for roles: Super Admin (Dashboard), Admin/PIC (RAB/KAK Gen), Relawan Lapangan (Mobile OCR).
For the 'Relawan Lapangan' view, do not build a standard desktop layout. Build a mobile phone frame using tailwind classes and put the OCR scan flow inside it.
The AI Generate KAK feature must display a formal A4-styled document preview (font-serif, white background, A4 aspect ratio).
Use Chart.js for the Budget (Bar) and SLA (Doughnut) charts on the dashboard.
Ensure the application structure allows toggling between the Login page and the Dashboard views seamlessly.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on Emerald 700 passes APCA/WCAG. Use Emerald 800 for hover states.
accessibility.testing: All key elements must have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit', data-testid='ocr-scan-btn').
